description: This file provides utility functions for parsing numbers in network protocol contexts, including functions to parse integers and unsigned integers with various formats and error handling.

classes.name: ParseIntFormat
classes.description: Enumeration specifying the format to use when parsing integers, including options for non-negative, optionally negative, and strict formats.

classes.name: ParseIntError
classes.description: Enumeration indicating the reason why a parsing function failed, such as overflow, underflow, or parse error.

methods.name: ParseInt32
methods.description: Parses a string as a 32-bit signed integer according to the specified format, returning success status and error details.

methods.name: ParseInt64
methods.description: Parses a string as a 64-bit signed integer according to the specified format, returning success status and error details.

methods.name: ParseUint32
methods.description: Parses a string as a 32-bit unsigned integer according to the specified format, returning success status and error details.

methods.name: ParseUint64
methods.description: Parses a string as a 64-bit unsigned integer according to the specified format, returning success status and error details.
